author: Marvel Entertainment
description:
Unleash the power of Phoenix Cyclops!

An explosive all-rounder, Phoenix Cyclops controls the battlefield with devastating Optic Blasts, rushing attacks, and relentless close-range pressure.

In this Character Guide, learn how to generate Solar Shards and unleash his devastating Phoenix form, gaining incredible power at the cost of his own health.

Can you master the Phoenix Force before it consumes you?

Phoenix Cyclops is the first DLC character in MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls, available as part of the Year 1 Character & Stage Pass, included in the Digital Deluxe and Ultimate Editions.

The Year 1 Character & Stage Pass and Phoenix Cyclops are also available for purchase separately.

MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls available on PS5 and PC. Get it now!
